warning: Both closures are drawn from the rule itself: the Merrymeeting Bay Game Sanctuary from the corner waypoints Maine publishes (WGS84), and Haley Pond as the whole pond from its USGS outline. Maine also has state game sanctuaries, posted land and town discharge ordinances that are not drawn here — check the MDIFW law book and local rules before you hunt.
source: MDIFW migratory game bird rules, 2026–27 (Haley Pond; Merrymeeting Bay Game Sanctuary).

areas.d: No hunting inside the sanctuary, marked by orange buoys: the area east of the mouth of the Abagadasset River, south of Browns Point in Bowdoinham and the high-tension lines over the Kennebec, and west of the Chops Point shore in Woolwich. Corners (WGS84): NW 44°00.148′ 69°50.645′, NE 44°00.035′ 69°49.169′, SE 43°59.531′ 69°49.533′, SW 43°59.894′ 69°50.752′. Motorboats only between the Woolwich shore and the orange markers along the marsh edge. The rest of Merrymeeting Bay is open but has its own rules: no blinds or decoys left out overnight, and 10 mph outside the buoyed channels.
Closed to waterfowl hunting — the whole pond, in the Town of Rangeley and Dallas Plantation, Franklin County.
